integrity: Every subcode is enumerated exactly once through reduced-row-echelon representatives of subspaces of F_3^5. The standalone verifier checks all 2663 subcodes, the matrix and LCD Gram rank, projective column multiplicities, and a MacWilliams consistency calculation.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns only the particular displayed C3,2 matrix. It does not classify the 38 inequivalent [23,5,12]_3 LCD codes reported by the source, and it does not claim novelty for ordinary weight or dual-weight distributions already represented in the associated public dataset.
title: Higher-support geometry of the displayed ternary code C3,2
